name: Kabeyun
operator_name: The John & Anna Newton Porter Foundation
description_short: Overnight summer camp for boys ages 8 to 16 in Alton Bay, New Hampshire. Most campers attend one of two half-summer sessions. There is also a full-summer option, shorter introductory sessions for first-time campers ages 8 to 11, and a counseling internship for returning campers ages 16 and 17.

sessions.name: Counseling Internship (extended through Aug 15; returning campers)

warnings: Enrollment for 2027 opened October 3, 2026, so the session availability shown here may be out of date.
Two addresses are given. The street address is labeled for shipping (43 Camp Kabeyun Rd, Alton Bay, NH 03810). The mailing address is PO Box 35, Alton, NH 03809.
The Counseling Internship costs $7,710 in tuition plus a separate $360 spending allowance. It is for returning campers only.

Introductory sessions are open only to a limited number of first-time campers under age 12, for their first summer. They can extend their stay to the end of the half-summer session if their parents agree.
